title: How I Survive Market Crashes (And Find Opportunity)
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Indices sit near all-time highs on mega-cap concentration while thousands of stocks are down 20-40%+ from highs.
CoreWeave/Oracle financing, Anthropic valuation, hot CPI/PPI, yields and oil are concerns, but no trigger has broken the market yet.
After last week's sell-off markets are oversold, upside potential is large and beginners should not be short; buy dips in small portions.

calls.reason: Markets oversold after a fear-driven sell-off with nothing broken; markets tend to recover, though could take months.
calls.quote: The upside potential is so great for the market right now.

calls.reason: 21% pullback, ~11.7 P/E, huge revenue and profit, US can't buy Chinese memory; fair value shows ~42% upside.
calls.quote: I like Micron... I do see this as an opportunity I want to take advantage of.

calls.reason: Fundamentally a terrible loss-making business, but already sold off ~37% and oversold, so recovery risk makes shorting unattractive.
calls.quote: In my opinion, it's a terrible business... it's oversold enough that the risk of a potential recovery is too great
